verdict.rationale: Notion documents event triggers through webhooks: connections can subscribe to page updates, property changes and new comments, and Notion POSTs to your endpoint on changes. Internal connections are pitched for custom automations, and Custom Agents are promoted as keeping work moving 24/7. However, the evidence shows no native rule builder that pairs triggers with actions inside Notion, so you must host your own handler code to run the actions. Missing for 10: a documented in-product rule/trigger→action automation builder, evidence of agents firing automatically on events, and independent or hands-on corroboration of event-driven automation working in practice.
